ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Royalty
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Royal standards in wishes, titled guests in encounters, the Empire's visitors talking court and manners, and the Empire's levy as a world event.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Ideology
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Memes shape decree reactions and the colony's ways; a leader whose creed puts a ruler above the vote names the council; a holy war among the world events.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Biotech
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Children, coming of age and family life goals; xenotypes that never sleep or never eat aren't asked about beds or meals.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Anomaly
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Ghouls aren't treated as people (no life goals, quirks, dreams or friendships), and the Almanac covers the entities.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Hospitality
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Guests are visitors with stories: eight encounters with journals, a guest who wants to stay (taken in Hospitality's own way) and a guest's complaint, a guest room wish and room plan, and a guest of note among the events. Guest beds never count as free beds. Its peoples remember a delighting or a disappointing visit. A lonely colonist may keep a guest company, guests raise their cups at the council's toasts and say a word about their stay, and This week lists who is staying and how it's going; guests always stay in Hospitality's own hands.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Dubs Bad Hygiene
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Bathroom, bathhouse, sauna and laundry room plans; wishes for a latrine, a wash, a bath and hot water; advisor checks; journal days and moments about washing. Its moods feed the feelings, a hot bath eases strain and shortens a convalescence.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vanilla Social Interactions Expanded
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its lessons, venting, rescues and best friends feed Rimfolk's bonds and journals; Rimfolk's own versions step back so nothing doubles up. Its moods feed the feelings, and sharing the burden eases strain.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: A RimWorld of Magic
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Classes as tags in offices, decrees and wishes; magic moments between colonists (a mage and a fighter talk shop), journal days, six life goals, traveling mages, starfall and a season of wild magic. Its moods feed the feelings, spent magic builds strain, healing magic shortens a convalescence, and a personal story for the classes.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Alpha Animals
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Encounters that name its creatures (aves, mits, sky eels, a gallatross passing), a strange creature to win over, strange herds as a world event; its dangerous beasts are never offered as game. Its creatures' moods feed the feelings.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Alpha Biomes
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Encounters on its lands (the gallatross graveyard, idyllic meadows, the mycotic jungle, the ocular forest), and its biomes read as deserts, swamps and jungles for land lines. Its weathers and waters feed the feelings, the healing spring eases strain, and two of its lands have an ailment of their own.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vanilla Skills Expanded
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its passions are read from their definitions, and earning an expertise is a life goal.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Alpha Skills
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its passions count by how fast they make someone learn, so apathy isn't a passion and critical passions count as burning.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vanilla Traits Expanded
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its traits react to decrees, sway elections, voice wishes and speak in their own tone.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes, Alpha Memes
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Their memes react to decrees and the colony's ways; aristocratic, royal and god-emperor creeds let the leader name the council. Calendar days suggest their rites (tea ceremony, trading fair, wicker man). Alpha Memes' artists, water-blessers, ranchers and monastics have moments of their own, and its iconoclasts, gladiators and bulwarks social events.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vanilla Cooking Expanded
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Grills and gourmet dishes count as fine or lavish meals for feasts, wishes and journals; grills ruined by the cold don't count. A feast never serves a spoiled grill.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vanilla Brewing Expanded
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its barrels count for brewing wishes; tea, coffee and soda aren't "something to drink" for the brewer; tea has a journal day. A toast is raised with its wines, or its tea for teetotalers.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vanilla Outposts Expanded
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Someone posted at an outpost is still one of the colony; their wishes wait, and they write home in their journals.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: RimHUD
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Eleven lines and six bars for its pawn panel: trust, open wish, office, life goal, strain, feelings, the heart's needs, ailments, recovery, the personal story and a healer's standing.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Interaction Bubbles
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Rimfolk's moments, encounters, social events and wish talk go into the social log, so they show as bubbles.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vanilla Factions Expanded - Empire
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Deserters on the roads: a world event where a deserter from the Empire asks the colony for shelter. Its balls, exhibits, honors and titles' wants feed the feelings.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vanilla Factions Expanded - Classical
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: The republic votes: a world event about the consular election; visitors from the republics talk of the senate and of masonry. A republic remembers the colony winning over its senate. Its one-person tents are what camps sleep in.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vanilla Factions Expanded - Settlers
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Gold fever: a world event with prospectors on the roads; settler visitors tell tall tales and teach rope tricks.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vanilla Events Expanded
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: The advisor explains its world conditions and what to do about them. Its aurora is awe and the superbloom's drone dread in the feelings.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Megafauna, Dinosauria and other animal mods
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Danger is read from each creature, so the hunting wish picks ordinary game and nobody takes on a giant beast alone.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Medieval Overhaul
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its pies, stews, cheese, wine, ale and library have journal days; visitors meet the colony's cheese, wine, hearth, oven, hives and books; its watermill isn't electricity, its firewood, rings and hearth fulfil wishes. A hall room theme of its rustic furniture and floors, its royal furniture in the stately theme, and its hide and cloth tents in camps.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Rimedieval
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Events it removes stay removed, hidden buildings are never suggested, and friendly mechanoids count as none.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Processor Framework
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its fermenting barrels count for brewing wishes and room plans.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Outland
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its four peoples visit (tea with the Eastborn, a Motz at dusk, haggling with the Redburn Pact, a Vathun's questions about caste); the Vathun and the Eastborn make a lord's progress past the colony, and the Pact gathers its clans. Its tent flap is a camp tent's door.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Medieval Total Rim
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its nations visit in their own words (a knight on the road, a rider of the steppe, a learned traveller), make a lord's progress past the colony, and the khaganate gathers its clans. They are known by their mod, so every nation pack counts.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Alpha Props: Parks and Gardens
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: A garden room theme: its lawns underfoot and its working street lights.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Humanoid Alien Races
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Every humanlike race gets the Story tab, and ages are read against the race's lifespan.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Alpha Genes
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its xenotypes' needs are respected (no meal wishes for those who don't eat); sunfed people have their own tag. Nereids, efreet and drakonori have wishes of their own. Nereids talk of the deep, the warm-blooded warm cold hands, the lapis read the stone; helixans, wretches and mind devourers have social events of their own.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Simple Sidearms
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: An heirloom weapon carried as a sidearm still counts as carried.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Vehicle Framework
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Someone aboard a vehicle or in flight is still one of the colony: no grief, no "gone" in the annals.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Big & Small
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Someone it gives a new race or a new body is looked at afresh: who they are is read again at once, wishes the new body can't use are set aside without blame, and the change gets a line in their own journal. Their records carry over.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Character Editor, Pawn Editor
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: A name, trait, age, gender or xenotype changed in the middle of a game is read again at once; wishes that no longer fit are set aside without blame, and someone left without an inner life has theirs set aside. Nobody's records are lost.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: PokéWorld
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Animal events follow its wild Pokémon settings, a caught Pokémon counts as tamed, animal lovers ask to catch new species, and four Almanac pages explain it.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Therapy
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: A session on the couch is relief in the feelings and eases strain like a talk with a friend.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Gastronomy
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Good service at the restaurant is contentment in the feelings, a long wait frustration.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Snap Out!
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Talking someone down from a breakdown is tenderness in the feelings of the one who did it.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: ReGrowth
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: A hot spring eases strain and shortens a convalescence; bathing, waste and being soaked or sandy feed the feelings.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Geological Landforms
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its landforms are read as valleys, canyons, islands, caves, cliffs, oases and craters, with encounters for each.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: More Vanilla Biomes
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Its alpine meadows and crags read as mountains and its oasis as an oasis for the land's encounters and lines.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Seasonal Weather
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: The double rainbow, windy days and dust storms each bring an encounter; lines can ask for its weathers by name.

ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.label: Stoneborn, Elves, Merfolk and Det's xenotypes
ColonyCouncil.ModSupportDef.what: Each people has wishes, decree likes and a pull on the colony's ways of its own: stone for the Stoneborn, flowers and books for elves, water for merfolk, a nest egg for boglegs.
